cash_session_closed_shape.name: cash_session_closed_shape
cash_session_closed_shape.value: "closed_at" IS NULL OR ("closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "counted" IS NOT NULL AND "expected" IS NOT NULL)

receipt_kind_shape.name: receipt_kind_shape
receipt_kind_shape.value: CASE "kind" WHEN 'payment' THEN "amount" > 0 AND "reverses_id" IS NULL WHEN 'reversal' THEN "amount" < 0 AND "reverses_id" IS NOT NULL WHEN 'refund' THEN "amount" < 0 AND "reverses_id" IS NULL ELSE 0 END
